mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO vm_record_download_t (batch_id,device_code, channel_code, start_time, end_time, download_status, memory_cycle, creator,delete_flag,create_time,tenant_id,industry_code, warning_order_id,table_type,operate_source_type) VALUES
( #{item.batchId},#{item.deviceCode}, #{item.channelCode}, #{item.startTime}, #{item.endTime}, #{item.downloadStatus},#{item.memoryCycle}, #{item.creator}, 0, now(), #{item.tenantId}, #{item.industryCode},#{item.warningOrderId},#{item.tableType},#{item.operateSourceType} )
mapper.update: UPDATE vm_record_download_t SET delete_flag = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT t1.id, t1.batch_id AS "batchId", t1.device_code AS "deviceCode", t1.channel_code AS "channelCode", ( case when length(IFNULL(ten.device_name, '')) = 0 then t3.device_name else ten.device_name end ) AS "deviceName", ( case when length(IFNULL(ten.channel_name, '')) = 0 then t2.channel_name else ten.channel_name end ) AS "channelName", t1.start_time AS "startTime", t1.end_time AS "endTime", t1.download_status AS "downloadStatus", t1.file_size AS "fileSize", t1.file_name AS "fileName", t1.order , t1.local_url AS "localUrl", t1.creator, t1.create_time FROM vm_record_download_t t1 LEFT JOIN vm_channel_info_t t2 ON t1.channel_code = t2.channel_code AND t1.device_code = t2.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_device_info_t t3 ON t1.device_code = t3.device_code AND t3.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_channel_rel_t ten on ten.device_code = t1.device_code and ten.channel_code = t1.channel_code and ten.tenant_id = t1.tenant_id and ten.delete_flag='0' and ten.industry_code = t1.industry_code WHERE t1.delete_flag = 0 AND t2.delete_flag = 0 AND operate_source_type = 1 ${dataScope} ORDER BY t1.download_status ASC, t1.create_time ASC

SELECT t2.device_code AS "deviceCode", t2.channel_code AS "channelCode", ( case when length(IFNULL(ten.device_name, '')) = 0 then t3.device_name else ten.device_name end ) AS "deviceName", ( case when length(IFNULL(ten.channel_name, '')) = 0 then t2.channel_name else ten.channel_name end ) AS "channelName" FROM vm_channel_info_t t2 LEFT JOIN vm_device_info_t t3 ON t2.device_code = t3.device_code AND t3.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_channel_rel_t ten on ten.device_code = t2.device_code and ten.channel_code = t2.channel_code and ten.delete_flag='0' AND ten.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ten.industry_code = #{industryCode} WHERE t2.delete_flag = 0 AND t2.channel_code IN
#{item}
